newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland to announce tender for cellphone system.
newsitem.headline: Poland to announce tender for cellphone system.

text.p: Polish Telecommunications Minister Andrzej Zielinski said on Monday he expected in January to announce a tender for a firm to operate a new digital mobile phone network operating on the DCS 1800 system.

"I expect that in January we will issue an announcement about a tender for the operator of a cellular phone network working on the DCS 1800 system...we will award the concession in the first half of the year and maybe even in the first quarter," Zielinski told a news conference. @

Tenders to run Poland's two new GSM digital telephone networks, which began operating this year, caused controversy because they were won by firms other than Ameritech and France Telecom, TPSA's partners in the earlier Centertel SA analogue telephone system.

The foreign firms argued they had invested in Centertel after being assured this would ensure them a share in the GSM digital business, and Ameritech this month sold its 24.5 percent stake in Centertel to its partners. @
Zielinski said that through negotiation a compromise had been reached between the government and Centertel's foreign investors and the abitration process had practically ended.
